title.narrative: Support and accompaniment for proposals presented to external donors in Central America

description.narrative: Currently, there are few funding opportunities beyond CAFOD's general fund (CGF), as Central America is not a region of primary interest to large institutional donors or governments. It is therefore key to support partners to increase their unrestricted income in the long term. Through this project we will provide direct support to improve conditions for our partners aimed to enhance existing opportunities identified by CAFOD and through dialogue with partners that can help them respond effectively to the complex needs of their communities, with a focus on civil society enabling evironment, sustainability and organisational strengthening. It is expected to increase the options for the strategic partners included in the Core Programme adopted in 2023. CAFOD will be respinsible to manage specific time-bound pieces of work, such as Design workshops, fundraising strategies, learning exchanges, generation of evidence, M&E systems and submissions within consortia and or partner-led proposals. These activities may be developed directly by CAFOD staff or by external consultants who will be supervised by CAFOD.
